title: Hematocrit
attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
measures: Hematocrit is reported as part of a complete blood count, a group of blood tests that measure the number and size of the different cells in the blood.
low: MedlinePlus does not list causes for a low hematocrit on the complete blood count page. A complete blood count is used to help investigate conditions such as anemia.
high: MedlinePlus does not list causes for a high hematocrit on the complete blood count page.
notes: A complete blood count is used as part of a checkup or to monitor overall health, and results are interpreted together with the other cell measurements and with symptoms and medical history.
